glosses: To come into contact with, or to put (something) into contact with, water, rain, mist, or another liquid.

examples.text: I stood too close to the waterfall, and I got wet.
The steel of this tool isn't stainless, so if you get it wet, you need to dry it off promptly.

glosses: Of a woman, to become sexually aroused, as indicated by the occurrence of the natural lubrication of the vagina.

examples.text: Sometimes I get wet right away, but other times I'm aroused but not very wet.
